title: Plank Pillars-木板柱子
description: Change all plank double slabs to plank pillars...
body:
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

### Let double slabs "stand up", giving you a brand-new set of decorative blocks!

</details>



- This resource pack rotates the texture of all vanilla double slabs from horizontal to vertical.
- Supports other texture packs
  
———————————————————
- 该资源包将所有木制双半砖的纹理改成柱子
- 支持与其他材质包同时加载
